service.description: A putaway rule of one of the user's facilities (FACILITY_EDIT, PERMISSION_DENIED; another organization's facility FACILITY_UNAVAILABLE): what it applies to (a source location or location type, a product, a product category, a storage type), its destination (a location, or a location type with an optional area), its priority (lower first) and an optional capacity with its unit (empty: the stock unit). With putawayRuleId the rule in effect ends where the changed one starts (fromDate, now or later), or ends now with endNow; key fields are audit-logged under the reason (REASON_REQUIRED). Refuses a destination that is closed (LOCATION_CLOSED), an ended rule (RULE_ENDED), a stale change (RULE_CHANGED) and an invalid value (RULE_INVALID).

A facility's putaway rules in effect now and to come, or every row with includeHistory, by priority, each with what it applies to, from where and to where in words, its capacity and dates. Any user with the facility in their scope reads (FACILITY_UNAVAILABLE otherwise); canEdit says whether they may change them.

Where stock goes: an asset (its facility, product, quantity on hand, owner, status and location), or a product and quantity at a facility (from a source location or location type; none is a receipt, which counts as receiving). Tries the product's default locations (ProductFacilityLocation), then the destinations of the rules in effect at asOfDate (now by default) that apply, by priority, each checked: open (LOCATION_CLOSED, FACILITY_CLOSED), not where the stock is (SAME_LOCATION), a storage location (NOT_STORAGE; quarantined stock only in quarantine, QUARANTINE_ONLY), a status the stock may take (STATUS_FLOW), the storage type (STORAGE_TYPE), one owner (OTHER_OWNER), and the location's and the rule's capacity with what is coming to it (CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, RULE_CAPACITY; CAPACITY_UNMEASURED for stock it cannot measure). Answers the first that fits and every candidate with its explanation, or NO_DESTINATION with the reasons. Reads only; the facility must be in the user's scope (FACILITY_UNAVAILABLE, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: quantity
parameter.description: The stock unit; the asset's on hand by default.

parameter.name: asOfDate
parameter.description: The rules in effect then (a rule to come can be tried); capacity is now.

parameter.name: locationSeqId
parameter.description: The destination, empty when none fits.

parameter.name: candidates
parameter.description: Each tried location: locationSeqId, locationText, source, sourceText, putawayRuleId, chosen, ok, reasonCode, explanation, statusAfter, capacity, occupied, incoming, remaining, capacityUnitText.

service.description: How full the open locations of a facility are (the given ones, else those with a capacity, at most 200): capacity in the location's unit, occupied, incoming (the putaway queue's stock of the products whose default location it is, less excludeAssetIds), remaining, and the stock that cannot be measured in that unit (unmeasured; such a location cannot claim spare capacity). With productId and quantity, whether it fits. No capacity is no limit. Reads only; the facility must be in the user's scope.

parameter.name: capacityRows
parameter.description: locationSeqId, description, locationTypeEnumId, limited, capacity, capacityUomId, capacityUnitText, occupied, incoming, remaining, unmeasured, measured and fits.
